quantity-stepper.description: a new `step` prop (default 1): the − and + buttons change the value by `step` instead of 1; `min` and `max` still clamp the result
quantity-stepper.mnx:
<!--
  A number with − and + buttons, between `min` and `max`. A form control.
  @fires valuechange - The value changed; `detail` is the new value.
-->
<script>
  // A `step` prop: how much − and + change the value by (1 by default); `min` and `max` still clamp.
  function change(by) {
    const next = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value + by * step))
    if (next === value) return
    value = next
  }
</script>
<style>
  :host { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
  button { width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ccd); background: var(--surface, #fff); font: inherit; font-size: 1.125rem; cursor: pointer; }
  button:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; }
  output { min-width: 2ch; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
</style>
<quantity-stepper form-associated value:model={1} min={0} max={10} step={1} label="Quantity">
  <button type="button" class="less" aria-label={`Fewer ${label}`} disabled={value <= min} onclick={() => change(-1)}>−</button>
  <output aria-live="polite" aria-label={label}>{value}</output>
  <button type="button" class="more" aria-label={`More ${label}`} disabled={value >= max} onclick={() => change(1)}>+</button>
</quantity-stepper>

toggle-switch.description: a new `disabled` prop (default false): when true the switch cannot be toggled (the button is disabled and marked aria-disabled), and the control submits nothing with the form even when checked
